wikitext.*: {{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |mode= Basketball |year= 2020–21 |team= Niagara Purple Eagles |image= NiagaraUWordmark.png |image_size= 150 |conference= Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference |division= |short_conf= MAAC |CoachRank= |APRank= |record= 9–11 |conf_record= 7–9 |head_coach= [[Greg Paulus]] |hc_year= 2nd |asst_coach1= Bryan Smothers |asst_coach2= Brett Ervin |asst_coach3= Kevin Devitt |stadium= [[Gallagher Center]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2020–21 MAAC men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Niagara Purple Eagles men's basketball team''' represented [[Niagara University]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Purple Eagles, led by second-year head coach [[Greg Paulus]], played their home games at the [[Gallagher Center]] in [[Lewiston, New York]] as members of the [[Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference]] (MAAC). They finished the season 9–11, 7–9 in [[2020–21 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference men's basketball season|MAAC play]], to finish in a four-way tie for fifth place. As the No. 5 seed in the [[2021 MAAC men's basketball tournament|MAAC tournament]], they defeated No. 4 seed [[2020–21 Marist Red Foxes men's basketball team|Marist]] in the quarterfinals,{{Cite web |date=2021-03-11 |title=Niagara Advances To MAAC Semis With 67-62 Win Over Marist |url=https://purpleeagles.com/news/2021/3/11/mens-basketball-niagara-advances-to-maac-semis-with-67-62-win-over-marist.aspx |access-date=2025-03-10 |website=Niagara University Athletics |language=en}} but lost to No. 9 seed [[2020–21 Iona Gaels men's basketball team|Iona]] 64–70 in the semifinals.{{Cite web |date=2021-03-12 |title=Furious Comeback Falls Short In MAAC Semis |url=https://purpleeagles.com/news/2021/3/12/mens-basketball-furious-comeback-attempt-falls-short-in-maac-semis.aspx |access-date=2025-03-10 |website=Niagara University Athletics |language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Niagara Purple Eagles men's basketball team|Purple Eagles]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 12–20 overall, 9–11 in MAAC play, to finish in a tie for sixth place. As the #6 seed in the [[2020 MAAC men's basketball tournament|MAAC tournament]], they defeated #11 seed [[2019–20 Marist Red Foxes men's basketball team|Marist]] 56–54 in the first round.{{Cite news|url=https://maacsports.com/news/2020/3/10/mens-basketball-manhattan-iona-and-niagara-advance-to-mens-quarterfinals.aspx|title=Manhattan, Iona and Niagara Advance to Men's Quarterfinals|work=Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference|date=March 10, 2020|access-date=January 15, 2021|language=en}} Before they could face #3 seeded [[2019–20 Rider Broncs men's basketball team|Rider]] in the [[2020 MAAC men's basketball tournament|MAAC tournament]] quarterfinals, all postseason tournaments were cancelled amid the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.poughkeepsiejournal.com/story/sports/2020/03/07/maac-tournament-2020-bracket-schedule-how-watch-tv-ncaa-basketball/4936528002/|title=MAAC Men's Basketball Tournament 2020 canceled due to coronavirus concerns|work=Poughkeepsie Journal|date=March 12, 2020|access-date=January 15, 2021|language=en}} == Roster == {{CBB roster/Header|year=2020|team=Niagara Purple Eagles|teamcolors=y|high_school=yes}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Justin|last=Roberts|num=0|pos=G|ft=5|in=10|lbs=189|class=sr|rs=y|home=[[Lawrence, KS]]|high_school=[[Toledo Rockets men's basketball|Toledo]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Kobi|last=Nwandu|num=1|pos=F|ft=6|in=6|lbs=210|class=sr|rs=y|home=[[York, PA]]|high_school=[[Le Moyne Dolphins|Le Moyne]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Tahjae|last=Hill|num=4|pos=G|ft=6|in=2|lbs=180|class=fr|home=[[Hilton, NY]]|high_school=[[Hilton High School]]}} {{CBB roster/Player|first=Marcus|last=Hammond|num=10|pos=G|ft=6|in=2|lbs=160|class=jr|home=[[Queens, NY]]|high_school=[[Benjamin N.
